milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the packed_ice tower (centered at spawn-relative 9, 2, 9) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because when a sandstone_wall block is mined with a pickaxe, it drops as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe (sufficient for sandstone-tier blocks) and no sandstone_wall in inventory, so having at least 1 sandstone_wall item confirms successful mining.
